# Ghost Draw

> Play a free blind drawing game online. Draw with hidden ink, reveal every stroke, try daily drawing challenges and share replays with friends. No download or account.

Draw something without seeing the ink, then let the ghost reveal every stroke. Try a daily prompt or your own idea, and invite a friend to draw the same thing.

The browser game needs JavaScript. You can still read the guide or get the iPhone and iPad app.

## Pages

- [Draw](https://ghost-draw.luopeike.com/): Play a free blind drawing game online. Draw with hidden ink, reveal every stroke, try daily drawing challenges and share replays with friends. No download or account.
- [Help](https://ghost-draw.luopeike.com/help): Learn blind drawing in the browser or iPhone app: free drawing, daily prompts, stroke replay, local gallery and sharing the same challenge with friends.
- [Privacy](https://ghost-draw.luopeike.com/privacy-policy): Ghost Draw privacy: browser-local drawings and drafts, optional iCloud in the app, public replay sharing and usage statistics with an off switch.
- [Support](https://ghost-draw.luopeike.com/support)

## Product summary

- [English](https://ghost-draw.luopeike.com/index.md): Play a free blind drawing game online. Draw with hidden ink, reveal every stroke, try daily drawing challenges and share replays with friends. No download or account.

## Optional

- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6773654307): The app offers a native drawing experience and optional iCloud gallery sync. The browser game can be played independently; installing the app is optional.

- [日本語](https://ghost-draw.luopeike.com/ja/llms.txt): ブラウザで無料のブラインドお絵描き。見えない線で自由に描き、毎日のお題に挑戦し、一筆ずつ公開。リプレイを友だちと共有できます。ダウンロード・登録不要。
- [한국어](https://ghost-draw.luopeike.com/ko/llms.txt): 브라우저에서 무료로 블라인드 그림을 그려 보세요. 자유 그림, 매일 주제, 숨긴 선의 공개, 로컬 갤러리와 친구에게 보내는 리플레이 링크. 다운로드나 가입이 필요 없습니다.

- [Русский](https://ghost-draw.luopeike.com/ru/llms.txt): Бесплатная игра в рисование вслепую в браузере: свободные рисунки, задания дня, раскрытие штрихов и повторы для друзей. Без скачивания и регистрации.
- [简体中文](https://ghost-draw.luopeike.com/zh-Hans/llms.txt): 在浏览器里免费玩幽灵画手：看不见笔迹的画画小游戏，支持自由绘画、每日绘画挑战、逐笔揭晓、本地画廊和回放分享。和朋友挑战同一个题目，无需下载或注册。
